rationale: Svelte spells a module script block two ways: context="module" and the bare `module` attribute. The corpus writes the bare form (shadcn-svelte sv-addons/registry/template/src/lib/registry/ui/button/button.svelte opens `<script lang="ts" module>`; 21 shadcn-svelte files carry a module block). isModuleContextBlock compared the start-tag TEXT for the literal context="module", so every bare-`module` block was read as an INSTANCE block: its exports were reclassified as component props (ownerName set, isSvelteProp on a constant) and exports[] stayed empty. This fixture pins the module API for the bare spelling: the module block's exports reach exports[] with SFC-coherent ranges, carry no component ownership, and are not contains members; the instance block's `export let` is still the prop.
